title: 第两千四百零七章 紫萱表态第两千四百零六章 树屋饭局
content_zh:
“在旁边直接搞一个小餐厅，就那么三四桌的，需要预约的那种。而且，不允许刘雨鑫来探店！”谢瑜在一旁加了一句，惹得我们大笑起来。
“刘雨鑫是谁啊？”赖永昌纳闷了，这很让我出意料，他不明白我们的笑点。
冰冰赶紧给他解释，他才反应过来，而且是勉强反应过来的那种。这种真实反应，也让我庆幸刚才在饭桌上没有直接给他来个最真实的项目需求展现，不然，他应该下不来台。我有这种想法，我承认是有点冲动，甚至是想用这种方式来稀释自己之前在铜钱岭项目上的种种不快。真的有点莫名奇妙之感，就是那种基督山伯爵跳入冰冷海里得到自由后的第一反应。
但是我按捺住自己这种想释放的天性，别人哪怕是敌人来到你的地盘，赤手空拳的，你却想用重机枪扫别人满身窟窿？不厚道。能让对手心悦诚服的，比扫对手满身窟窿更有说服力。就是因为在饭煮熬上不说任何一个关于铜钱岭的字儿，但所有苗头都指向项目，这才行。
饭后没多久，赖永昌就告别了，安静依然带着两个保安，开着小火车在山下静静的等着。等他在树下的小火车上车回头望树上的我们打招呼时候，虽然我和龙凤哥是真诚的笑着和他回招呼，但谢瑜在一旁职业性的微笑时，那一刻在场所有的眼光对碰着，我知道，我们要拿的话，就能拿下铜钱岭这个项目。再看着小火车在山腰间以之字形来回蜿蜒缓慢的上升，我已然确认，这样的话，是将银海湾仅有的障碍，严格意义来说，已经没有障碍属性的障碍，就此扫清。
说没有障碍属性的障碍，那是因为铜钱岭没有了运营的活力，也就没有了和我们掰手腕的能力，成了纯正物理意义上的障碍。反而就是这种物理障碍，还会影响到我们的运营。所以，必须扫清。从大酒店和山妖酒吧的眼界去看海，这铜钱岭项目就是绕不开的障碍。好了，今儿能清了去，甚是慰怀。
可可还没有来，但紫萱的电话却来了。我隐隐的直觉，是可可告诉她的。因为就在刚才，谢瑜说要可可过来，然后我就告知了她。如果是这样，我心里就有点不太痛快了，毕竟紫萱的态度很重要，但她和潘若安的羁绊，却又让这项目的解决增添了不确定的因素。现在这个电话，似乎将我刚才的快意给一扫而空了。
龙凤哥醒目，看到了我脸上一闪而过的表情，便走到谢瑜跟前介绍起温泉水来了。
我走到一旁，接了紫萱的电话：“喂，紫萱啊！吃晚饭了吗？”
“没吃你给我点外卖啊！”电话那头说。我一时间没有听出来这情绪的变化是否存在，便小心翼翼的说：
“好啊！除了龙肉之外的，都可以点。”
“去你的！”电话那头那头终于有了笑声，“还是有了底气的林凡，就是不同啊！”
“哪里哪里！”我说，“没有你，我哪里来的底气！只能吸煤气咯！”
“我有火机啊！”她哈哈哈笑了起来，“点你！”
“我在空旷的树屋区呢！”我笑着说，“点了也不爆炸。”
“你走后我想到现在啊！”她说，“期间可可我也问了，然后想了想，你说的铜钱岭项目，我怎么听了那么模棱两可呢？你不能给个痛快？”
“你什么意思呢？”我说，“我谨慎一点不行吗？”
“嗨，你还在给我绕圈圈？”紫萱说，“我最喜欢的决策是怎样的，你不是忘了初心吧？”
嘿，这一句话算是点穴，点到了我的死穴，几乎。
我说：“你说果断就果断的呀？万一错误了呢？”

“你变了！”紫萱说，“变得有点懦弱了啊！不像你呢！是不是以前的林凡给人换了呢？”
我知道她在激我。这一激，反而拴紧让我心里有了个底儿：
“我说，万一错误了，万劫不复啊！”
“嘿，谁让你梭哈？”紫萱说，“你没判断好，会下注？你判断好了，不会下注？一下注，你就梭哈？不会吧你？我问你，如果项目拿下来，就是两根指头的事儿对吧？”
“估计是。”我压低声音，“我正在和银行的人谈着呢！现在！这银行的人，刚好就是和我在一个单位大院里一起长大的，女。”
她笑了：“你为什么要强调女呢？青梅竹马的？”
“不是不是！”我也笑了，“太熟了，不好下手。哦，或者说，太熟了，不好意思下手。”
“去你大爷的！”紫萱笑得更大声了，“你以为当年的你，貌若潘安啊！还是才华横溢？”
我一本正经的回答：“嗯，两者皆而有之吧！”
“不和你插科打诨了。”紫萱说，“今晚给你电话，是想了又想之后的决断。这项目，我们要拿下，一定要拿下！如果是两个指头的事，我和你讲项目分成几份啊！入股的，来啊！首先保证原来股东。如果原来的股东没钱但又愿意的，我和你能先给垫着吗？你垫不来，我来垫！如果原来股东有钱愿意的就不用说了。如果有钱没钱都不愿意的，我们也不勉强嘛！要么另外找人，要么就我和你吃了这个项目如何？我说的你，是将你和可可视为一体了啊！”
“这样啊？”我心里一阵悸动，心跳明显过速，“我没问题！你说怎样就怎样。”
“这可是你说的啊！”紫萱说，“铜钱岭项目要另外和度假村完全分开，但操盘还是你来。不过，我有点私心啊！”
“私营企业，没有私心怎么行？你说吧！”我说，“怎么个私心法？”
“我想要将我妹妹带进来。然后你带着，哦，然后是可可带着可以不？”紫萱问我。
“只要你妹妹不像是我前小舅子老康小舅子那样的主儿，就一定没问题。”我说，“对了，我带不行吗？”

content_en:
"Build a small restaurant next to it, with just three or four tables, the kind that requires reservations. Moreover, Liu Yuxin is not allowed to visit the store!" Xie Yu added on the side, making us laugh.
"Who is Liu Yuxin?" Lai Yongchang was puzzled. This surprised me. He didn't understand the point of our laughter.
Bingbing hurriedly explained to him before he reacted, and he barely reacted. This kind of real reaction also made me glad that I didn't give him the most realistic project requirements directly at the dinner table. Otherwise, he would not be able to get off the stage. I have this idea, and I admit it is a bit impulsive, and I even want to use this method to dilute my previous unhappiness with the Tongqianling project. It's really a bit of an inexplicable feeling, just like the Count of Monte Cristo's first reaction after jumping into the icy sea and getting free.
But I suppressed my natural desire to release myself. Even if others are enemies who come to your territory with bare hands, you want to use a heavy machine gun to shoot holes all over their bodies? Not kind. Being able to convince your opponent is more convincing than sweeping holes all over his body. It’s just because there’s not a word about Tongqianling in the rice cooker, but all the signs point to the project, that’s why.
Not long after the meal, Lai Yongchang said goodbye. An Jing still took two security guards and waited quietly at the foot of the mountain in a small train. When he got on the small train under the tree and looked back at us to say hello, although Brother Longfeng and I smiled sincerely and greeted him back, when Xie Yu smiled professionally at the side, everyone's eyes met at that moment. I knew that if we wanted to win, we could win the Tongqianling project. Watching the small train slowly ascending in a zigzag pattern on the mountainside, I have already confirmed that this will clear the only obstacle in Silver Bay. Strictly speaking, it has no obstacle attribute.
It is said that there are no obstacles with the nature of obstacles, because Tongqianling has lost its operational vitality, and has lost the ability to compete with us. It has become an obstacle in a purely physical sense. On the contrary, this kind of physical obstacle will also affect our operations. Therefore, it must be cleared. Looking at the sea from the perspective of the hotel and Troll Bar, the Tongqianling project is an unavoidable obstacle. Well, I am very relieved to be able to clear up today.
Coco hasn't come yet, but Zixuan's call has come. My vague intuition was told to her by Coco. Because just now, Xie Yu asked Coco to come over, and then I informed her. If this is the case, I feel a little unhappy. After all, Zixuan's attitude is very important, but the bond between her and Pan Ruo'an adds an element of uncertainty to the resolution of this project. Now this phone call seems to have wiped away all the joy I had just felt.
Brother Longfeng was alert and saw the flash of expression on my face, so he walked up to Xie Yu and introduced the hot spring water.
I walked aside and answered Zixuan's call: "Hey, Zixuan! Have you had dinner?"
"If you don't want to eat, please give me some takeout!" said the other end of the phone. I couldn't tell for a while whether this emotional change existed, so I said cautiously:
"Okay! You can order anything except dragon meat."
"Fuck you!" There was finally laughter on the other end of the phone, "Lin Fan still has confidence, it's just different!"
"No way!" I said, "Without you, where would I have the confidence? I can only breathe gas!"
"I have a lighter!" She laughed, "Light you up!"
"I'm in an empty tree house area!" I said with a smile, "It won't explode if I light it."
"After you left, I thought about it now!" she said. "I also asked about it during the period, and then I thought about it. Why was the Tongqianling project you mentioned so vague to me? Can't you just give me a break?"
"What do you mean?" I said, "Can't I be more cautious?"
"Hey, you're still givingDo I go around in circles? Zixuan said, "What is my favorite decision? Have you forgotten your original intention?" "
Hey, this sentence is a critical point, it hits my Achilles heel, almost.
I said: "You said you were decisive? What if something is wrong? "
"You have changed! Zixuan said, "I have become a bit cowardly!" Not like you! Has the old Lin Fan been replaced? "
I knew she was motivating me. This excitement, on the contrary, made me feel confident:
"I said, if you make a mistake, you will be totally doomed! "
"Hey, who asked you to stud? Zixuan said, "You don't have good judgment, how can you place a bet?" You have made a good judgment and don’t know how to place a bet? Once you make a bet, you will stud? Can't you? Let me ask you, if the project is won, it will be a matter of two fingers, right? "
"I guess so. "I lowered my voice, "I'm talking to the people at the bank! Now! The person in this bank happens to be a woman who grew up in the same work unit compound as me. "
She laughed: "Why do you emphasize women? Childhood sweetheart? "
"No no! "I also laughed, "It's too familiar to start with. Oh, or in other words, it’s too familiar and I’m embarrassed to start. "
“Fuck you uncle! Zixuan laughed even louder, "Do you think you looked as good as Pan An back then?" Or talented? "
I replied seriously: “Well, it’s both! "
"I won't make any jokes with you anymore. Zixuan said, "I called you tonight because I made a decision after thinking about it over and over again." We must win this project, we must win it! If it’s a matter of two fingers, let me tell you how many parts the project should be divided into! Shareholders, come on! First, ensure the original shareholders. If the original shareholder has no money but is willing, can you and I help first? If you can't help me, I'll help you! If the original shareholders have the money and are willing, it goes without saying. If you don’t want it even if you have money or no money, we won’t force it! Either find someone else, or just me and you, how about this project? When I say you, I regard you and Coco as one! "
"Is that so? "My heart palpitated, and my heart beat obviously too fast, "I'm fine! Whatever you say will be done. "
"This is what you said! "Zixuan said, "The Tongqianling project must be completely separated from the resort, but you are still in charge. However, I am a little selfish! "
“How can a private enterprise operate without selfish motives? Say it! "I said, "What kind of selfish method? "
“I wanted to bring my sister in. Then you bring, oh, and then Coco, is it okay? "Zixuan asked me.
"As long as your sister is not a master like my former brother-in-law, Lao Kang, then there will be no problem. "I said, "By the way, can't I take it? "
